results.description:
Scattered elder care information everywhere? Elderella is one secure place for everything about your parent, spouse, or aging relative's care.

If you've been searching for a family caregiving app that actually helps, this is it. Ella turns your conversations, notes, and documents into a plan you and your care team can act on.

HOW ELDERELLA HELPS

* Builds and activates your care team of family, friends, and professionals and keeps them in the loop so you don't have to repeat yourself. Chat with them right in Elderella, one-on-one or as a group, and Ella picks up the care details. You choose what each person can see.

* Collects elder care details automatically from everywhere and everyone (chats in Elderella, your family's group chat, calendars, phone calls, appointment recordings, voice notes, photos, emails, and documents).

* Answers anyone on your care team instantly from your care memory, showing each person only what they're allowed to see, and flags what needs attention.

* Records and transcribes calls to your elder's dedicated phone number, so the care team never misses what was said. Share the number with doctors, pharmacies, and anyone else who calls with important information.

* Records appointments so you don't have to take notes. Ella adds any new instructions, tasks, and events from what was said.

* Snap the hospital discharge instructions, and Ella adds the follow-up appointments, medications, and tasks.

* Keeps every prescription, supplement, and vaccine on one list.

* Tracks anything you want to keep an eye on, like headaches, sleep, or how often someone visits. Tell Ella in your own words, and the tracker shows the pattern over time.

* Gets you started and shows what's been handled and what still needs to be done. Pin what you use most so it's one tap away.

* No signal in the waiting room? Elderella still opens to what you last saw on your phone, and the details you add sync once you're back online.

USER TESTIMONIALS

"What Ella actually lifts is the cognitive load that was quietly breaking me. My one real regret is not bringing it into the loop earlier. My siblings are experiencing all of this remotely, and the tension that builds inside families during caregiving is very real. I think we'd be on better terms now if Ella had been part of the picture from the start." - Sherryl T.

"Elderella has been a tremendous support in helping organize care responsibilities, improve communication, and reduce the mental load that comes with managing so many moving pieces." - Suzanne H.

"Helps me keep track of the ever-changing list of meds prescribed to my father, as well as appointments with health professionals and their contact info. And I can share this with others on our care team." - Debbie C.

WHAT SETS US APART

Built by family caregivers, and informed by family doctors, geriatricians & frail elder physicians, nurses, estate planners, lawyers, bankers, caregiver organizations, and elder care advocates.

100% ad-free forever.

FREE TRIAL

Start your 7-day trial of Elderella Plus with full elder care features including appointment recording, call protection with a dedicated phone number, 10 care team members, and unlimited care memory.

Free plan includes: the care map, medication & vaccine tracking, care team chats, custom trackers, calendar sync, 5-minute voice notes, 3 care team members, and 90-day care memory.

PRIVACY

Your family's information is encrypted, never sold, and you decide who sees what. Designed to align with PIPEDA (Canada) and HIPAA (US) standards. Delete your information at any time.

Elderella does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or emergency services. Always consult qualified professionals for medical decisions or urgent concerns.

Terms of Use: https://www.elderella.com/terms

Lively Link™, a free app for your smartphone, keeps you informed about the health and safety of loved ones who subscribe to a Lively Health and Safety plan.

Link can provide peace of mind by sharing timely updates about your loved one. You can check in with them when you want, from anywhere, without disturbing them – helping them maintain the independent life they love.

Exclusive features help them stay independent and you feel reassured.

Once you accept the invite from your loved one and successfully set up Link, you’re able to access the following features:

Receive Emergency Alerts

Link will send you notifications for selected actions including when your loved one has contacted Urgent Response on their Lively device, allowing you to make decisions quickly and follow up without delay. 

Retrieve Location

When the locator permissions are on you will see your loved one’s location on a map and receive updates if they change location. These general updates happen approximately every 20 minutes. 

In an emergency, First Responders get location updates every 30 seconds. 

Check Activities
Based on information in the Lively device user’s Personal Profile, see if appointments are being kept and receive other reports about their activities.

Check Device Status

Get peace of mind knowing your loved one always has access to a professional in the event of an emergency. Link will let you know the Lively device Battery Status. You’ll also be notified when the battery is low so you can remind your loved one to recharge or replace the battery and stay connected. 

Get Articles to Help You Support Your Loved One

Resource center featuring helpful articles, advice and tips for seniors and their loved ones.

Personalization

The Link team cares that the app is tailored to you. That’s why there are settings allowing you to choose which notifications you receive, add a picture of your loved one and even save their phone number – so you can call them directly from the app.

We want you to have a great app experience. If you have any questions about the Link app or simply can’t find your favorite features, email us at customerservice@lively.com we’ll be glad to help.

https://www.lively.com/link

results.description:
Caring for an aging parent is never a one-person job. When reminders, doctor visits, and the "did anyone pick up the prescription?" texts pile up in a chaotic group chat, something always slips. Home Care Organizer gives your whole family one calm, shared place to run it all.

This is an organizer for the logistics of caregiving, not medical advice. It helps you plan, remind, share, and keep track, so the person you love gets steady, coordinated care, and nobody has to carry every detail in their head.

ONE SHARED PLACE, NOT SIX SCATTERED APPS

Instead of a whiteboard, a notes app, three calendars, and a group text nobody scrolls back through, everything lives together. Anyone helping can open the app and instantly see what is done, what is coming up, and who is on it. No more "I thought you had that."

WHAT YOU CAN DO

- Build a care profile for your loved one, with name, relationship, and simple notes, so everyone shares the same starting point.

- Keep a shared task list. Add jobs like "pick up prescription" or "call the clinic," assign them to a specific family member, set a due date, and check them off together.

- Track every appointment in one calendar. Add doctor and specialist visits with the provider, location, and notes, then set a reminder (15 minutes, 30 minutes, 1 hour, or a day before) so nobody misses one.

- Set medication reminders. Add each medication and the times you want a nudge, then log each one as taken or skipped to keep a clear adherence record. The app reminds you of the time only, and never suggests, adjusts, or comments on what or how much to take.

- Keep a shared care log. Note visits, calls, and updates ("Visited this afternoon, ate well, in good spirits"). Over time it becomes your family's shared memory of how things are really going.

- Save the numbers that matter. Keep the doctor, pharmacy, nurse, and family contacts together so anyone can reach the right person fast.

- Generate prep checklists. Pick a situation, a specialist visit, hospital discharge, home-safety walkthrough, organizing medications, a caregiver rotation, new-diagnosis questions, arranging in-home help, or gathering documents and legal paperwork, and get an organizational checklist: questions to ask, papers to bring, and tasks to divide up. Coordination only, never diagnosis or treatment.

FREE TO START, NO ACCOUNT NEEDED

Jump straight in as a guest, with no sign-up wall. On the free plan you can organize care for one loved one on your own device: unlimited tasks, appointments, and care-log entries, medication reminders, saved contacts, and a sample prep checklist. It is a genuinely useful single-caregiver organizer, at no cost.

GO PRO WHEN THE FAMILY NEEDS TO SHARE

The moment you want to bring siblings and other helpers in, Pro unlocks:

- Cloud family sharing, so tasks, calendar, and the care log stay in sync in real time across everyone's phones.
- Unlimited medication reminder profiles and full history.
- Unlimited prep checklists for every new situation.
- Multiple care recipients, to coordinate for more than one loved one.
- Export your care log and appointment history as a PDF for your own records.
- No ads.

Pro is available as a monthly or annual subscription, because caregiving is a season of life. The core organizer stays free, and Pro is there when the whole family needs to be on the same page.

A NOTE ON WHAT THIS APP IS

Home Care Organizer helps you organize and coordinate care. It does not provide medical, dosing, or health advice. For any medical question, please consult a licensed professional; in an emergency, call your local emergency number.

Get everyone on the same page, so nobody is guessing, and nobody is carrying it alone.

Location Sharing, With Consent

results.description:
Elavo - Stay connected, stay supported

Caring for a loved one with memory loss can feel overwhelming - and staying connected with the rest of the family while doing it can feel like one more thing to manage. Elavo brings your whole care circle into one calm, simple space.

PRICING
Free for 2 months, then $3.99/month for your whole care circle. Cancel anytime in your App Store subscription settings.

APPLE HEALTH SHARING AND FALL ALERTS (IPHONE)
With your loved one's permission, Elavo shares daily summaries of their steps, sleep, heart rate and walking steadiness with the caregivers in your circle. You get an alert when their Apple Watch records a fall or a heart notification, and you can set your own alerts, like a day with very few steps.

DOCTOR-VISIT REPORT
Make a PDF of recent health trends with one tap, and bring it to appointments.

CHECK-IN AND NUDGE
See when your loved one last opened Elavo. If they've gone quiet, send a Nudge with one tap. Everyone in the circle sees who already checked in.

MOOD AND ACTIVITY
See your loved one's mood check-ins and daily activity, and how they're trending over the week.

CARE COMPASS
Step-by-step checklists for the big caregiving jobs, like paperwork, medical planning and safety at home, so nothing important slips through.

FIND CARE NEAR YOU
Search nearby nursing homes, home health agencies and hospice.

WEEKLY EMAIL SUMMARY
An email each week with your loved one's mood, plus health trends when Apple Health sharing is on.

FOR FAMILY AND CAREGIVERS

ChecKin — Automated Care Check-Ins for Your Loved Ones

Is your parent doing well today? With ChecKin, you don't have to wonder. Set up automated voice calls and text messages that check in on your elderly loved ones — on your schedule, in their language.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Add a care recipient (parent, grandparent, or any loved one)
2. Set a check-in schedule — choose call or text, pick the days and time
3. ChecKin automatically reaches out at the scheduled time
4. Your loved one responds by pressing a button or speaking
5. You get an instant notification with their response

KEY FEATURES

● Automated Voice Calls & Texts
Schedule daily or weekly check-ins. ChecKin handles the outreach so you can focus on everything else — knowing your parent is just a call away.

● Easy Set Up
For our parents, a new app can feel like a chore. That’s why with ChecKin, your loved one doesn’t need a smartphone, a new login, or even a computer. Only a simple one-time verification is needed.

● Your Voice, Their Comfort
Record a personal voice message in your own voice. Hearing from you — even automated — means the world to them.

● Smart Retry
No answer? ChecKin automatically tries again. No check-in slips through the cracks.

● Instant Notifications
Get notified the moment your loved one responds. Listen to their voice recording right from your phone.

● Timezone & Language Support
Your parent lives in a different timezone? No problem. ChecKin schedules calls in their local time and speaks their language.

DESIGNED FOR LONG-DISTANCE CAREGIVERS
Whether you live across town or across the country, ChecKin bridges the distance with a simple, reliable daily touchpoint. It's not a replacement for your love — it's an extension of it.

SUBSCRIPTION
ChecKin is free to download and set up — add your loved one, verify their number, and build your check-in schedule before subscribing. When you're ready for check-ins to begin, start your 7-day free trial with full access to every feature. After the trial, continue with a monthly or annual plan (annual saves 17%). Current pricing for your region is always shown in the app before you confirm.

Premium includes:
- Up to 2 care recipients
- Up to 2 schedules per recipient
- Custom voice messages
- 90-day recording history

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID account settings.
